description: EDGAR's full-text search across every SEC filing since 2001: which filings mention a phrase, by whom, when. Filter by form (10-K, 8-K, S-1, DEF 14A...), company and dates. Use quotes for an exact phrase ('"going concern"'), OR between alternatives. Returns the total, the top filers, and the matching documents with links. A match only means the words appear; read the passage with filing_text before saying what a filing says.

company.description: Only this company's filings (ticker, name or CIK)

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default one year ago)

name: filing_search
title: Search every SEC filing (EDGAR full text)
